summary: Iteration 4 frontend e2e verification of the 3 fixes applied by main agent. FIX 1 (PBKDF2 5000 iters) is CONFIRMED WORKING: registration completes in ~1.8-2.5s (well under the 3s target) and re-login of an existing 5000-iter user is <1s. FIX 3 (Board initial-load) is partially working: on first mount without any chip switch, rows now DO populate but only after ~7s (19 rounds x 2 sequential Supabase kvList calls = 38 HTTP requests; not a code correctness bug but a performance one). FIX 2 (Logout crash) is STILL BROKEN: tapping logout-row STILL emits the same 'Maximum update depth exceeded' React error repeatedly (hundreds of times) and the app never lands cleanly on the auth-card — the router.replace('/') in more.tsx onPress does not eliminate the ping-pong because (tabs)/_layout.tsx still has `if (!me) return <Redirect href='/' />` and index.tsx still has `if (me) return <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />`; the two declarative Redirects continue to fight. Italian error surfacing on the auth gate all works: 'Password errata', 'Utente non trovato', 'Username già in uso' render correctly in [data-testid=auth-error]. LEGACY_ITERATIONS branch is present in session.tsx login() (`iters = rec.iters ?? LEGACY_ITERATIONS`) — verified by code review; no legacy 150000-iter user was tested against because no such record was known.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout STILL triggers 'Maximum update depth exceeded' infinite React loop. router.replace('/') alone in more.tsx does NOT stop the ping-pong because both (tabs)/_layout (`if (!me) return <Redirect href='/' />`) and index.tsx (`if (me) return <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />`) still fire declarative Redirects reactively during the me=null transition. Console spams the error hundreds of times per second; the app becomes unresponsive.

Board first-mount now DOES eventually populate (fix works) but takes ~7 seconds because load() runs 19*2=38 sequential Supabase kvList calls for lms1. Users see 'Nessun dato disponibile' for 6-7s before rows appear. Consider Promise.all-ing the round loop or precomputing an aggregate.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the Maximum-update-depth loop above. Cannot verify 'log back in' step follows because the app never returns to a clean auth-card state after logout — the same crash pattern from iteration 3 persists.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents in the offending component.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the logout redirect ping-pong. router.replace('/') in more.tsx is not enough. Preferred fix: remove the declarative `<Redirect href='/' />` from /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx and instead render `null` (or a loader) when !me — rely on the imperative router.replace('/') in more.tsx's logout onPress. Alternatively, replace the Redirect in (tabs)/_layout with a useEffect that calls router.replace('/') once (guarded with a ref) to avoid re-firing on each render. Same principle for index.tsx: change `if (me) return <Redirect href='/(tabs)' />;` to a `useEffect(() => { if (me) router.replace('/(tabs)') }, [me])`.

MEDIUM: Speed up Board initial load. Right now board.tsx `load()` awaits 38 Supabase requests sequentially for lms1 (worse for whowin: 76). Parallelise with Promise.all across the round range and/or fetch a single combined view.
LOW: Migrate the deprecated `props.pointerEvents` usage to `style.pointerEvents` to silence the console warning.

rca_of_issue: Logout crash RCA (unchanged from iteration 3): expo-router's declarative <Redirect> in both `(tabs)/_layout.tsx` (when !me) and `app/index.tsx` (when me is truthy) create a bidirectional redirect. When me flips truthy→null during logout, React re-renders (tabs)/_layout, which renders <Redirect href='/'/>. expo-router then mounts index at '/' but re-render cycles between the two routes fire faster than React can settle the tree, causing Maximum update depth. The correct fix is to make ONE side imperative (useEffect + router.replace) and the other side render null. Main agent's iteration-4 fix only added router.replace('/') in more.tsx AFTER logout(); but the two Redirects still fire during the same render cycle and cause the loop regardless of the imperative call. Board slowness RCA: board.tsx load() has `for (let r = g.rounds[0]; r <= g.rounds[1]; r++) { await kvList(...); await kvList(...); }` — 38 sequential requests to Supabase for lms1 (76 for whowin) at ~150-200ms each = 6-8s wall-clock. Parallel Promise.all across the round range would drop this to ~1s. Registration + error-surface RCA: all working correctly.
